payload.name: pc-classify-value
payload.description: Classify an optional raw value while preserving the distinction between missing and null. Reads the raw candidate with inputs.get('value') so an absent key and an explicit null are distinct. Returns {state:'missing',value:null} when the key is absent, {state:'null',value:null} when the value is exactly None, {state:'value',value:<original>} when the value is an exact integer in 0..10 inclusive (booleans and floats are rejected), and {state:'invalid',value:null} for any other value. No defaults, coercion, exceptions, imports, host calls or I/O. Pure logic; makes zero Tool calls.
